theorem parallelReduction_diamond : Diamond ParallelReduction := by
  intro a a₁ a₂ h₁ h₂
  have hk := h₁
  induction h₁ generalizing a₂
  case refl => exact ⟨_, h₂, .refl _⟩
  case par p q r s hp hq ip iq =>
    cases h₂
    case par c d hc hd =>
      rcases ip hc hp with ⟨_, hx, hx'⟩
      rcases iq hd hq with ⟨_, hy, hy'⟩
      exact ⟨_, .par hx hy, .par hx' hy'⟩
    · exact ⟨_, .refl _, ‹_›⟩
    · cases hp; exact ⟨_, .red_I _, hq⟩
    · rcases Ka_irreducible _ _ hp with ⟨_, hz, rfl⟩; exact ⟨_, .red_K .., hz⟩
    · rcases Sab_irreducible _ _ _ hp with ⟨_, _, hu, hv, rfl⟩
      exact ⟨_, .red_S .., .par (.par hu hq) (.par hv hq)⟩
  all_goals cases h₂
  all_goals first
    | case red_I.par c d hc hd => cases hc; exact ⟨_, hd, .red_I _⟩
    | case red_K.par => rcases Ka_irreducible _ _ ‹_› with ⟨_, hz, rfl⟩; exact ⟨_, hz, .red_K ..⟩
    | case red_S.par c d hc hd =>
        rcases Sab_irreducible _ _ _ hc with ⟨_, _, hu, hv, rfl⟩
        exact ⟨_, .par (.par hu hd) (.par hv hd), .red_S ..⟩
    | exact ⟨_, .refl _, by constructor⟩
